snippet.title: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered - Official Announce Trailer | PRE-ORDER NOW!
snippet.description:
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered is now available for PRE-ORDER on all platforms!

Get up to 10% OFF with the PRE-ORDER DISCOUNT* now through November 9th.

The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics. 

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

*The pre-order discount applies to all platforms, PS+ required for discount on PS5.

Visit the Website
